values.en: For a regular smooth parametrized surface $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$, the first fundamental form is positive definite: if $q\in\Omega$, $w\in T_{q}X$ and $w\neq 0$, then $\mathrm{I}_{X}(q;w,w)=\lVert w\rVert^{2}>0$. Equivalently, the coefficient matrix $\begin{pmatrix}E&F\\F&G\end{pmatrix}$ is positive definite, which is exactly $E>0$, $G>0$, $EG-F^{2}>0$. This is what makes the induced form an inner product and lets it measure lengths and angles on the surface.
values.zh-CN: 对正则光滑参数曲面 $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$，第一基本形式正定：若 $q\in\Omega$、$w\in T_{q}X$ 且 $w\neq 0$，则 $\mathrm{I}_{X}(q;w,w)=\lVert w\rVert^{2}>0$。等价地，系数矩阵 $\begin{pmatrix}E&F\\F&G\end{pmatrix}$ 正定，即 $E>0$、$G>0$、$EG-F^{2}>0$。正定性使诱导形式成为内积，从而能在曲面上度量长度与角度。

values.en: Positive Definiteness of the First Fundamental Form
values.zh-CN: 第一基本形式的正定性
